actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /app
printf '== image info ==\n'
file /app/isos/win311.img || true
printf '\n== qemu/nginx availability ==\n'
command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || true
command -v nginx || true
printf '\n== listening sockets before ==\n'
ss -ltnp || true
printf '\n== process snapshot ==\n'
ps -ef | sed -n '1,120p'
